legacyPushMigrationRehearsal.method: Apply the prior 33-migration image, insert one enabled legacy iOS PushDevice, then deploy the final image.
legacyPushMigrationRehearsal.interpretation: The retained row is ineligible in required mode until foreground re-registration binds a live session; explicit disabled-mode re-registration can opt it back into disabled-mode delivery.

notes: This validates the dependency-resolution, computer build, application build, and migration stages, not the final Debian computer runtime image.
